title: OrderLateChangesArrived
description: Published by Click and Collect when an update arrives for a store fulfillment whose order has already moved past CREATED, so the change reaches the store after picking may have started. orderId and fulfillmentId are the same pair cnc.public.event.order-status-changed.v1 carries for the row, so a consumer can close this notification on the fulfillment terminal status. Messages on this topic are not ordered.

internalOrderId.description: Click and Collect internal id of the order row the late change was applied to

orderId.description: Id of the customer order the fulfillment belongs to

fulfillmentId.description: Id of the store fulfillment the late change was applied to

businessUnitId.description: Id of the business unit fulfilling the order
